description: Process deviations: (1) the brief asked for per-task branches session-<id>/<task>; this session is pinned to the single branch arena/bf34205f-own4 and did its tasks sequentially, one commit each. (2) When this PR was opened, four other sessions had already merged a separate framework site (root index.html, pages/, docs/) into main; nothing of theirs was discarded. This session's site lives in lab/ and is linked from the root nav; COORDINATION.md and .gitignore conflicts were resolved by keeping both.

No official source for betting odds was available, so market edge / closing-line value (gate G6) cannot be tested, no ROI is reported and no strategy can be 'Betting-validated'. Own lines are model prices, not compared to any book.

description: No official bulk player box-score logs were retrieved, so player-prop strategies (PROP-POINTS, PROP-COMBO) are Blocked and every player-level correlation is blank and marked UNVERIFIED.

Injuries, lineups, rest and travel are not modelled (no official injury report was fetched). Eight teams in the Nov 2 slate played on Nov 1 (BOS, BKN, IND, ORL, LAC, GSW, TOR, LAL) so the lines may be biased for those games. Back-to-back flags are shown in the own-lines table but do not change the line.

Official pages were read through a text-extraction proxy and transcribed by script/hand; there is no cryptographic or screenshot-level proof that file contents equal the pages. Internal consistency across three different nba.com page types is checked by scripts/verify_data.py, but a human spot-check against the links in each row is still advised.

At the original commit 319d6b0 the repo had only README.md ('# Own4', one line, no trailing newline): no description, licence, tests or CI. Main has since gained a richer README, tests and a validation workflow (other sessions), but there is still no LICENSE (the owner's decision) and the CI workflow covered only docs/ - this session added steps for verify_data.py and check_site.py.

The pre-registered total model is biased: it over-predicts totals by 3.7 points on average over the 92 games (2025-26 mean total 231.2 vs 227.4 so far in 2026-27). Gate G5 therefore fails for BLEND-41-TOTAL. The registered lines are NOT altered after the fact; an exploratory bias-adjusted total is shown beside them.

Every result rests on 92 games (13 days). The pre-registered minimum is 300 out-of-sample games, so no strategy can be Forecast-validated yet. Differences between models are within noise (all bootstrap CIs include 0). Straight-up hit-rate of 66% looks good but its 95% interval (56-75%) is wide and it was not a gate.

Extreme own lines (UTA @ SAS -18.5, BKN @ NYK -17.0, MIL @ MIN -13.5) rest on 6-7 games of current-season data blended with 2025-26 ratings, with no opponent adjustment and no adjustment for injuries. Treat as low-confidence.

2025-26 home split on the official stats page covers 1,225 games, not 1,230, because five games were played at neutral sites (SAS, DET, NYK, ORL, MEM show 40 home games; standings list neutral-site records for 7 teams). The home-court margin H=+1.725 is computed on the 1,225 home games.

Two static sites coexist on Pages: the framework site (root and /docs/, qualitative research specification from other sessions, no measured results) and this Data Lab (/lab/, real transcribed data, own lines, walk-forward results). Their conclusions agree (no validated strategy) but they are maintained by separate generators (build_site.py + scripts/build.py vs site_src/build_site.py).
resolution_needed: Owner to decide whether to consolidate
